name: Jasmin OS — Personal Productivity App
goal: Add a Tasks / To-Do module to the Expo React Native app: the user can add a task, mark it closed (done), and delete it — mirroring the existing Follow-ups and R&D modules, with per-user Firestore storage and its own tab. (This sits alongside the in-flight Wallet feature roadmap.)
summary: Multi-module personal app (Follow-ups, R&D, Wallet, Profile) on Expo + Firestore. Wallet roadmap is mid-flight; now adding a Tasks/To-Do module with add / close / delete.
